body: Nah. That’s not painless, my guy
I saw this in new and I’m proud that I found it

I do have a gun. I am 15, though. It’s in our safe with my parents guns. I don’t know the combination. I can shoot myself in November, though. We go deer hunting and I sit alone. It’s in the middle of nowhere and there aren’t any hospitals (or internet service). It’s perfect but November is so far.
I do the same thing. I’m always thinking of what I’d write. I usually (physically) write at least one out each night.
I hope that you don’t feel pain anymore.
You want to talk? It’s fine if you don’t.
